description: Export one whole list of the user's own Parfumo collection, with every field, as JSON (default), as a complete CSV built by this server (custom columns included), or as Parfumo's own 10-column CSV (`csv_site`). Long exports come in parts: pass `next_cursor` back until it is absent and concatenate the parts. Requires a linked Parfumo account.

oneOf.description: Every field of every bottle as JSON objects.
CSV built by this server with every field, custom columns included.
The CSV file Parfumo itself generates (10 columns only).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor to continue a long export: the `next_cursor` of the previous response.

name: parfumo_export_collection

CollectionItem.description: One bottle (entry) of a collection list, with the member's private fields.

added.description: Date the entry was added (`YYYY-MM-DD`, UTC). Set by the site, not editable.

bottle_size.description: Bottle size as entered (millilitres, free text on the site).

custom.description: Values of the member's custom columns, by column name.

entry_id.description: Identifier of this entry in the list (Parfumo `wr_id`).

has_statement.description: True when the member wrote a statement / a review on this perfume.

last_worn.description: Date of the last logged wear (`YYYY-MM-DD`, UTC).

perfume_id.description: Perfume identifier usable with every perfume tool (`Brand/Perfume`).

perfumers.description: Details resolved from the list dictionaries (omitted in compact listings).

private_note.description: The member's private note on this bottle.

url.description: Absolute Parfumo URL of the perfume.

CollectionList.description: One list of the member's collection (ShelfControl `data-lists`).

count.description: Number of perfumes in the list.

custom.description: True for a list created by the member.

hidden.description: True when the list is hidden from other members.

id.description:
Numeric list id: 1 have, 2 had, 3 want (Wish List), 4 memo (Watch List), 5 tested,
6 filling (Decants), 7 mini (Miniatures); custom lists have a larger id.

slug.description:
Slug usable as `collection` argument: `have`, `had`, `want`, `memo`, `tested`,
`filling`, `mini`, or the numeric id of a custom list.

url.description: ShelfControl URL of the list (account page).

MemberRatings.description: Ratings a member attached to a review or statement.

csv.description: CSV text (formats `csv` and `csv_site`). The header line is only in the first part: concatenate the parts.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next part. Absent when the export is complete.

offset.description: 0-indexed position of the first row of this part.

returned.description: Number of rows in this part.

total_items.description: Number of bottles in the list.
